procedure: Classify financial unit and map applicable distributable capital constraints.
Implement the selected equity cash flow, dividend or residual income method.
Reconcile equity capital, continuing economics and ownership rights.
Challenge plausible alternatives and return unsupported inputs or unavailable execution.

acceptance.expectation: Balance-sheet intermediation does not use industrial FCFF/WACC; prudential applicability is evidenced.
Capital/equity rollforward, cash distributions, discount timing and rights allocation reconcile.
Clean-surplus adjustments and sustainable capital needs support the selected continuing-value method.
Funding already reflected in equity is not deducted again in group bridge; tool test states are explicit.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction

artifact_alias_semantics: Logical plan output names for the corresponding method records, not extra completed artifacts. Preserve unit, current version and actual completion/review state; a design or formula specification is not an executed model or reconciled numerical bridge.
